title: Why Pasan starts backend design from failure cases
summary: Pasan now starts most backend design sessions by mapping what can fail first, then shaping APIs and queues around those boundaries.
points: Defines timeout, retry, and fallback behavior before adding business logic.
Separates synchronous API paths from asynchronous event processing early.
Adds structured logs up front so production debugging is faster later.

title: What Kafka taught Pasan about service boundaries
summary: Using event streams helped Pasan reduce tight coupling between services and make deployments less risky.
points: Uses events to communicate state changes instead of direct service-to-service dependency chains.
Keeps event contracts explicit with versioning to avoid downstream breakages.
Treats idempotency as a first-class requirement in consumers.

title: How Pasan keeps AI workflows controllable with LangGraph
summary: Agentic systems become easier to trust when every step is explicit, reviewable, and resumable.
points: Uses plan → approval → execution flow for sensitive tool actions.
Stores checkpoints so interrupted sessions can resume cleanly.
Adds structured JSON outputs and logs for easier post-run analysis.

title: Guardrails Pasan applies to public AI chat features
summary: Public assistants need strict scope control, rate limits, and safer defaults to stay useful in production.
points: Limits assistant scope to portfolio topics and ignores unrelated misuse attempts.
Applies rate limits and optional API token checks on expensive endpoints.
Uses redacted logging by default outside development environments.

title: From internship tasks to production ownership
summary: Pasan shifted from implementing assigned tasks to taking responsibility for reliability, traceability, and maintenance impact.
points: Balances delivery speed with long-term maintainability decisions.
Writes clearer docs to reduce support and onboarding friction.
Treats observability and error handling as part of core feature delivery.

title: Docker + .env lessons from VPS deployment
summary: Small formatting issues in env files can silently break startup behavior in containers.
points: Avoids inline comments on env value lines when using docker --env-file.
Keeps numeric values unquoted where possible to reduce parser surprises.
Verifies runtime env values inside containers before deeper debugging.
